thread:
sam: Heads up — console shows sudden per-route quota drops for a handful of tenants after the rollout of route-resolver v5. No invoice changes yet.

lina: I see it too. Suspect route_alias is now populated and preview-agg dedupe uses route_id only. Might double-count when alias+id both present.

mike: quick grep: preview-agg dedupe key = f\"{req_id}:{route_id}\". route_alias only used downstream.

billing-bot: alert: preview_vs_ledger_delta high for tenants t-300,t-301 (ratio > 20x)

sam: important UX note — console quota card is single number; resellers are seeing negative available -> support tickets imminent.

ops-ira: mitigation options: 1) temporary toggle route-resolver v5 for affected tenants, 2) patch preview-agg dedupe to include route_alias if present, 3) mark preview rows as \"schema-unverified\" in console for these tenants. I'd prefer 2+3.

lina: patch minimal: dedupe_key = f\"{req_id}:{route_id}:{route_alias or 'na'}\". Need to ensure window still covers out-of-order arrival.

mike: bump dedupe window from 20s -> 45s while we roll. We'll add config flag.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0401-510 created, severity=P2; owners assigned: sam (owner), mike (patch), lina (recompute job), ops-ira (canary + rollback plan), devex (console messaging).

mike: I'll open a small PR with unit tests. Canary deploy to two preview shards in ~90m.

lina: I'll run a diff job ledger vs preview for the last 6 hours and prepare a backfill plan for any tenants with >5% delta.

devex: adding a quick console banner: \"Preview may be inflated for tenants affected by route-resolver v5 rollout; final invoices unaffected.\" Will also add an option to hide preview counts per org.

ops-ira: deployed banner and hide-flag for top-2 tenants. Monitoring looks stable but keeping incident open until patch + backfill done.

sam: thanks. please paste PR + canary link here. We'll capture the rollout checklist item: whenever routing metadata changes, confirm all downstream dedupe keys include new fields.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0401-510 status -> in_progress

mike: PR up: https://gh/redwood/preview-agg/pull/2123 (feature flag on).

lina: recompute done for t-300/t-301 window 02:00-08:00 UTC. preview delta corrected after canary.

ops-ira: canary looks good; scheduling full rollout in 30m. Will keep dedupe window increased for 24h.

sam: great work, closing once postmortem note and updated rollout playbook merged.
